title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Ballroom, U. of California on 1970-06-21

ai_review.summary: A solid audience tape that captures a high‑energy early‑70s show with standout Easy Wind, Not Fade Away and Good Lovin'.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) source typical of the era – a little hazy after three decades but surprisingly clear for its time, with some cuts that add to its historic charm. Musically the concert shines thanks to a fiery Easy Wind, a punchy Not Fade Away and a swinging Good Lovin', plus strong NFA → St Stephen flow. Overall the performance is praised as spirited and memorable despite the modest tape quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers highlight a great show with several standout jams, while acknowledging only moderate tape fidelity typical of vintage audience recordings.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hazy and slightly muffled after 35 years; some cuts (Not Fade Away, Good Lovin') but overall decent clarity for a 1970 AUD tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Rock‑heavy ’70 vibe with a freewheeling rush; the set builds nicely from Easy Wind into a strong NFA → St Stephen segment, keeping energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is noted for being on the verandah, smoking a joint and sharing the vibe with fans.
